# Vexaloom Labs Actor documentation

> Reference pages and API tutorials for the 141 public Apify Actors published by Vexaloom Labs. Every page is generated from the Actor's published README, input schema, output definitions and Store pricing, and regenerated when the published build changes. Prices are the published pay-per-event prices; runs happen on Apify.

- Catalog: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/
- Sites A to Z: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/sites/
- Topics: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/topics/
- Guides: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/
- Machine-readable index: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors.json
- Publisher on Apify: https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs

## AI

- [Crunchbase News & Funding Coverage Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/crunchbase-news-and-funding-coverage-scraper/): Extract Crunchbase's editorial news articles on startup funding, M&A, IPOs and tech trends: full text, author, publish date, categories, tags and featured image. Filter by keyword, category or date. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/crunchbase-news-and-funding-coverage-scraper/
- [Domain-Scoped Site Crawler for Markdown Datasets](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/domain-scoped-site-crawler-for-markdown-datasets/): Crawl a website from one or more start URLs, staying on the same domain, and get back clean Markdown, text, or HTML per page with title, description, and crawl depth. Built for feeding LLM, RAG, or knowledge-base pipelines. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/domain-scoped-site-crawler-for-markdown-datasets/
- [Google Maps Business Search & Reviews MCP Server](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/google-maps-business-search-and-reviews-mcp-server/): Search Google Maps businesses or pull reviews for a specific place through one actor, usable as a normal run or as an MCP tool for AI agents. Returns ratings, contact info, hours and flattened reviews. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/google-maps-business-search-and-reviews-mcp-server/
- [SimilarWeb Traffic & AI Chatbot Analytics Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/similarweb-traffic-and-ai-chatbot-analytics/): Look up website traffic estimates, rankings, traffic-source breakdown, top keywords, and AI-chatbot traffic share for any list of domains, with no login or API key needed. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/similarweb-traffic-and-ai-chatbot-analytics/
- [startup.jobs Category & Keyword Job Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/startup-jobs-category-and-keyword-job-scraper/): Collect startup job listings from startup.jobs by category and keyword, with title, company, work mode, salary, job type, listing text, tags, and the listing link. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/startup-jobs-category-and-keyword-job-scraper/

## Agents

- [Search & URL Markdown Extractor for LLMs](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/rag-web-browser/): Turn a search query or a list of URLs into clean Markdown, plain text, or HTML pages, with filters for domain, keyword, and minimum content length. No login or cookies needed. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/rag-web-browser/
